trigger_condition.device_trigger: CUDA tensor input to quantized tensor creation
trigger_condition.memory_trigger: Subsequent CPU allocation inherits pinned memory state
trigger_condition.state_trigger: Internal allocator or pinned-memory state leaks across operations
trigger_condition.execution_trigger: Call torch._make_per_tensor_quantized_tensor on a CUDA integer tensor, then allocate a CPU tensor

bug_oracle.description: After torch._make_per_tensor_quantized_tensor is called on a CUDA integer tensor, a newly allocated CPU tensor reports is_pinned() as True instead of False.
bug_oracle.signal: CPU tensor is_pinned() returns True unexpectedly

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Vary shapes and integer dtypes of CUDA input tensors while keeping the operation valid for quantized tensor creation.
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Construct CUDA integer tensors and invoke torch._make_per_tensor_quantized_tensor.
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Track allocator state and CPU tensor pinning flags before and after stateful quantized operations.
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: Run a stateful CUDA quantized tensor creation operation, then perform an unrelated CPU tensor allocation and query is_pinned().
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: Compare is_pinned() on a fresh CPU tensor allocated before and after the quantized operation; a change from False to True indicates leaked pinned-memory state.
